content.title: SlipClock: A Conditional Displayed-Depth Cost Benchmark for Evaluating Financial AI Strategies in Crypto Futures
content.abstract: Trading cost for a broad cross-sectional portfolio should be computed by aggregating conditional displayed-depth cost across its constituent orders. Order-level cost varies with contract, side, notional, and the contemporaneous L2 state. We propose SlipClock , a point-in-time benchmark that selects the universe using historical information, applies a common submission-time feasibility policy, and prices each resulting frozen order against minute-level L2 states. Its estimand is static VWAP cost relative to the midpoint, conditional on filling the order entirely from displayed depth. Across 494
